classic-linkedin.name: Classic LinkedIn Corporate
classic-linkedin.summary_zh: 通用 LinkedIn：自然、稳妥、头肩棚拍
classic-linkedin.direction: A classic American corporate headshot with a light warm-gray seamless background, a neatly fitted neutral blazer over a simple shirt or blouse, a relaxed modest smile, shoulders turned slightly while the face stays toward the camera, and soft balanced studio lighting with gentle facial modeling.

wall-street-finance.name: Wall Street / Finance
wall-street-finance.summary_zh: 金融：深色正装、克制自信，不改变年龄
wall-street-finance.direction: A restrained finance professional headshot with a charcoal or muted blue-gray seamless background, a well-fitted dark navy or charcoal suit and simple light shirt or blouse, an optional tie only if requested, a subtle approachable smile, and softly directional studio light with readable eyes and controlled contrast. Keep the subject's actual apparent age; avoid a stern expression, heavy shadows, luxury props, or executive-age styling.

consulting-mbb.name: Consulting / MBB Polished
consulting-mbb.summary_zh: 咨询：正式、温和、干净，无公司品牌暗示
consulting-mbb.direction: A polished consulting headshot with a neutral warm-gray background, a tailored understated blazer and clean light shirt or blouse, an attentive gentle smile, upright relaxed posture, and bright soft studio light that preserves facial depth. Convey a tidy professional presentation without logos, company associations, dramatic authority cues, or glossy magazine retouching.

big-tech-startup.name: Big Tech / Startup Professional
big-tech-startup.summary_zh: 科技：简洁 smart casual，轻松且职业
big-tech-startup.direction: A modern technology professional headshot with a clean pale-gray or softly muted blue background, a simple open-collar shirt, fine-knit top, or smart-casual blazer according to the subject's preference, a relaxed natural smile, and airy soft studio light. Keep the look professional and uncluttered; avoid hooded costume styling, startup props, office logos, or changing the subject's apparent age.

graduate-analyst.name: Graduate / Analyst
graduate-analyst.summary_zh: 校招：清爽正式、友好，保持本人年龄
graduate-analyst.direction: A graduate or entry-level analyst headshot with a fresh light warm-gray background, a well-fitted simple blazer over a plain shirt or blouse, a friendly unforced smile, relaxed straight posture, and clear soft studio light. Preserve the subject's actual apparent age and individuality. Avoid artificially aging or de-aging the face, senior-executive styling, university insignia, and claims of academic pedigree.
